feedback: Frank's confession follows directly from the open-bench image, installation revision, and his contrary claim. His admitted preview access and later poisoning fill in the act itself, but they confirm the inferred route rather than introduce a new decisive evidentiary trick. The drawing-versus-built-room metaphor suits an architect and connects his defensive lie to Grant's leverage. It is emotionally satisfying that the danger to future visitors remains his responsibility even after the donor dies. Hugh and Chip receive plausible denials that acknowledge real wrongdoing instead of erasing it. The resolution feels earned, although Frank's motive becomes more eloquent in confession than it was in his earlier frustrated account.
